seo.title: Thank you: cost estimate received
seo.description: Your cost estimate answers have reached Calwebtech. Here is what we do with them, when you hear from us and how the range becomes a fixed price.

title: Thanks. Your estimate is on its way.
intro: Your answers are stored with your enquiry, so nobody asks you the same questions twice. A copy of your estimate is on its way to the address you gave.

received.heading: What you sent us
items: Your answers about project type, timeline, page count and design depth
Your answers about content, integrations, the content management system and ongoing support
Your name and email address, so we can send you a copy

response.label: Expect a reply
response.detail: A person checks your range against projects of a similar shape and emails you anything that would move it.

steps.title: A person checks the range
steps.body: We read your answers and note the decisions that would move the number most, such as integrations or content.

steps.title: We email you
steps.body: You hear whether the range holds for your project and what would change it, in plain terms.

steps.title: A call if you want one
steps.body: If the range works for you, a thirty minute call turns it into a written proposal with a fixed price.

secondary.heading: Understand the number
secondary.body: See what moves a website quote up or down, and what every project includes as standard.
